title: Flat-Rate Chapters - Payment When Entitlement Is Used Up During a Term
content:
**Policy clause — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), flat monthly benefit of Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606.**

**Definitions.** The entitlement cut-off follows the entitlement ledger, the days granted plus every restoration minus every charge, and the resident term. *No entitlement remains* when that figure is nothing or less. The *last charged day* is the last day covered by the latest charge entry on the ledger. A day falls *inside the month* when it is one of the first thirty days of the month paid. The resident term's days are counted from the term start with both ends included.

**Clause.** The days payable for a month end no later than the entitlement cut-off, which is:

1. when no entitlement remains, the last charged day falls inside the month and more than half of the resident term's days, counted from the term start with both ends included, had passed by that day — payment continues through the earlier of the thirtieth day and the term end, because entitlement that runs out after the middle of a term is extended to the end of that term;
2. when no entitlement remains, the last charged day falls inside the month and no more than half of the resident term's days had passed by that day — payment stops on that last charged day;
3. when no entitlement remains and the last charged day falls before the month — nothing is payable for the month;
4. otherwise — the thirtieth day.

**Two-sided illustration (hypothetical 100-day resident term, no entitlement remaining, last charged day inside the month).**

| Days of the term passed by the last charged day | More than half? | Cut-off |
|---|---|---|
| 50 (the 50th day of the term) | No — exactly half | The last charged day |
| 51 | Yes | The earlier of the thirtieth day and the term end |

**Further cases (hypothetical).** Ledger showing 12 days remaining: cut-off is the thirtieth day. No days remaining and the last charge covered training ending in the month before: nothing is payable for the month.
